question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(1)
solution:
The correct answer is: **indicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Indicate"** means to point out or show; to be a sign of something; to state or express briefly. (संकेत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The red light on the dashboard indicates a problem with the engine.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that an asteroid as large as 10 kilometres (6 miles) in diameter is thought to have struck Earth towards the end of the Cretaceous period, according to a number of geological lines of evidence. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"indicate"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **indicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prevaricate **(टाल-मटोल करना): To speak or act in an evasive way.

 
 
• **Example:** The witness began to prevaricate when asked about his whereabouts on the night of the crime.
 
 
 
• **Sign **(संकेत ): An object, quality, or event whose presence or occurrence indicates the probable presence or occurrence of something else.
 
 
• **Example: **Dark clouds are a sign that it might rain soon.
 
 
 
• **Intimate** (संकेत देना): To suggest or hint something indirectly.
 
 
• **Example:** He intimated that he might retire soon.
